data.name: Aminah
data.gender_notes: Aminah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aminah is an Arabic name that means 'trustworthy' or 'faithful'. It is also the name of Prophet Muhammad's mother, making it a revered and sacred name in Islamic tradition. The name Aminah carries the meaning “Trustworthy, Faithful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aminah usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy, faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Aminah is associated with the concept of trust and faith in Allah, reflecting the importance of tawakkul (reliance on God) in Islam.
data.etymology: Aminah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy, Faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aminah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
